description: Search arXiv research papers by keywords, author or category — newest or most relevant — with abstracts, authors, dates and PDF links. arXiv's official API. query supports arXiv syntax (ti:, au:, abs:, cat:cs.AI, AND/OR). Paced to arXiv's one-request-per-3-seconds policy and cached, so repeated queries are instant. Price: $0.001 per call (10 free/day; after that a payment-required result lists x402 options). Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).

limit.description: How many papers to return. Range 1-30. Default 10.

query.description: e.g. "tool use agents" or au:hinton or cat:cs.CL AND ti:reasoning

sort.description: Order by relevance to the query or by submission date. One of "relevance", "newest". Default "relevance".

name: arxiv_search
title: arXiv paper search
